hero.headline: We Don't Succeed Unless You Succeed
hero.subtext: Our team is your team. You get a full, dedicated team led by senior partners — from first conversation to close.

senior_partners.name: Storm Duncan
senior_partners.title: Founder & Managing Partner
senior_partners.bio: Ranked one of the top 5 Tech M&A bankers of all time (VentureBeat), one of the 'top 50 M&A Dealmakers in the World' (Atlas M&A Awards), and winner of the 2024 M&A Leadership Award. Storm has 30+ years advising on iconic technology transactions including Google/YouTube, Google/DoubleClick, Tencent/Universal Music Group, Microsoft, Apple/Drive.ai, Tinder/Match, Oracle/Sun/MySQL/RightNow, Uber/Careem, Lyft, and AMD/NexGen. He is a guest lecturer at Harvard Law School and Stanford University, and co-taught and co-authored an M&A course at Stanford Law School.
senior_partners.education: B.A. Political Science and American Studies, Yale University; MBA Finance (With Distinction), University of Michigan

senior_partners.name: Kevin Finn
senior_partners.title: Senior Partner, Software
senior_partners.bio: Kevin leads Ignatious's software sector practice, bringing deep expertise in enterprise SaaS, vertical software, and tech-enabled services M&A. He has advised on dozens of transactions across growth and mature software businesses.

senior_partners.name: Chris Hayes
senior_partners.title: Senior Partner, Mobility
senior_partners.bio: Chris leads Ignatious's mobility and transportation technology practice, advising on transactions across fleet management, autonomy, ADAS, telematics, and logistics technology.

senior_partners.name: Joachim Over
senior_partners.title: Senior Partner, Internet
senior_partners.bio: Joachim leads Ignatious's internet and consumer technology practice, with extensive experience advising digital platforms, marketplace businesses, and consumer applications on both buy-side and sell-side mandates.

senior_partners.name: Ben Lee
senior_partners.title: Senior Partner
senior_partners.bio: Ben brings broad technology M&A and private capital advisory experience across sectors, with a focus on cross-border transactions and growth equity mandates.
